description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about pets in the cabin.

files.description: A Slack thread in #policy-updates between Skyway staff about pets in the cabin, dated between 2026-07-06 and 2026-08-18: a normal working conversation; one message may carry each sentence below. It must contain these sentences word for word: "From August 15 pet fees are not refunded on customer cancellations."; "refunded with the fare when Skyway cancels"; "no longer refunded when the customer cancels their own booking"; "This applies to every request handled from August 15, whatever the date of the flight.". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not end the thread with a summary of the answer. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
